p02-sofia-is-short.observed_description: Against a plain light-grey wall on a light wooden floor, Sofia (hair in a high bun, bright blue blazer, white blouse, black trousers, black flats) stands at the left, shoulder to shoulder with a very tall man at the right (short dark hair, navy crew-neck T-shirt, khaki chinos, navy sneakers); both smile at the camera. Sofia holds her right hand flat, palm down, just above her bun; the top of her head reaches only the man's shoulder. Head to feet, both centered.
p02-sofia-is-short.note: Usable. They stand shoulder to shoulder rather than strictly back to back, and the tall man does not match the established Luis closely (shorter, straighter hair); the sentence never names him. The height difference reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 tile.
